integrity: Analytical proof including standard Hurwitz approximation and Fibonacci best approximations; 8144 supplementary finite checks passed. No independent validation or audit.
limitations: The sharp conditioning constant is for derived, equally weighted three-line interference coefficients of a two-exponential entire-function sector, not raw-line intensity noise or infinite-dimensional stability. Four raw intensity sites depend on the sector frequency. No claim of a globally optimal full-space sampling design.
title: Golden-ratio optimality for resonant three-line exponential phase retrieval
